δίκην: δίκη — justice, right; fem. acc. sg., object of τίουσι ’honour justice’
θρέψεν: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic -εν (= Attic ἔθρεψε)
κεκαλυμμένος: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’covered, wrapped’
πλήθουσι: πλήθω — be full, swell, overflow; pres. 3 pl.: ’are full’
πλήξας: πλήσσω — strike; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck’
σάω: σαόω — save, keep safe; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic (= Attic σάου/σῴζε)
στενάχοντο: στενάχω — groan, lament; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they groaned’, + acc. ’lamented for’
χαλεπήνῃ: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, angry, deal harshly; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a clause of fear with μή: ’lest he be harsh’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general temporal clause with ὅτε: ’whenever (he) turns harsh’
ἅρματ: ἅρμα — chariot; neut. acc. pl. (pl. for a single chariot), elided (ἅρματ’ = ἅρματα)
ἐξεπέρησε: ἐκπεράω — pass right through, pass out through; aor. 3 sg., epic -ησε (= Attic ἐξεπέρασε)
ἐπέχραον: ἐπιχράω — fall upon, assail; aor. 3 pl., augment after the preverb (ἐπ-έ-χραον)
ἐρίφοισι: ἔριφος — kid; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἔρεβος: Ἔρεβος — Erebus, the dark of the underworld; neut. acc. sg.
ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg., no augment · also pres. imper. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μή: μὴ ... ἔρυκε ’do not detain (me)!’
ἤμβροτον: ἁμαρτάνω — miss (+ gen.); aor. 1 sg., epic strong aorist (= Attic ἥμαρτον): ’I missed’ · also ’err, make a mistake’, with acc. of respect (τόδε γ’ ἤμβροτον ’I erred in this’)
ὄπιν: ὄπις, -ιδος — regard, heed, awe (esp. of the gods’ retribution; sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg.
